# Validation record

The new analytic arguments were reviewed line by line. `checks/verify_revisions.py` then tested the new formal claims using exact rational arithmetic where probabilities and utilities were evaluated. It reused the project's finite normality generator and causal-definition implementations; it is not an independent implementation of every baseline definition.

- A5: 6,122 core-score parameter points, including positive affine-score intersections and interior points; 150 complete three-world belief-space comparisons. No counterexample to the comparative-statics result was found.
- A6: all 3,306 relative-defeat instances in the enumerated comparable statist structures with up to four states, with a reproducible full-support prior per instance; 194 small independent perturbations. The constructed conditional rule agreed with the unconditional rule at both stages, and looking was strictly worse. No failures.
- A4: all 355 reflexive/transitive category relations, including partial ones. Every nonempty candidate subset and every witness was considered in the six central models under all three definitions, with minimality imposed after filtering. 2,130 calibration and 3,195 paired-case comparisons; no failures. Inertial/event coding coincide for these cases.

The displayed A6 example was separately checked in exact arithmetic: present value 6/5, later policy value 1/2, difference 7/10. Old Gaussian numerical integrations, older broad batteries and the A5 linear-algebra check were not all rerun; their earlier records remain in the 25 October edition. No claim of fresh independent peer review is made.

Manuscript counts, source scans, PDF text/metadata checks and visual page inspection are recorded alongside this file. These checks do not certify literature completeness, eligibility or novelty.
